lines: +note: Estimate the bytes each querier job reads when it is created and compare the estimate with the bytes the job actually read. Adds `tempo_query_frontend_job_actual_to_estimated_bytes_ratio`, `tempo_query_frontend_job_cost_factor`, `tempo_query_frontend_job_cost_bytes_per_block`, and the `query_frontend.job_cost` configuration block

+  Estimates for jobs that read blocks are calibrated with the bytes the jobs actually read. The estimates are only reported and don't change how queries run. The sum of the estimates of the jobs of a query that were not served from the cache is logged and added to the request span as `estimated_bytes`, next to `inspected_bytes`.
+  Estimates for jobs that read recent data from the live store or the generators are fixed values set with `query_frontend.job_cost.live_store_cost`.
+    # Estimates how many bytes each querier job reads when the job is created. The estimates are only reported
+    # in metrics, they don't limit or change how queries run.
+        # Calibrate the estimates for jobs that read blocks with the bytes the jobs actually read.
+            # If disabled, the estimates use predefined constant values.
+            # Limits of the share of the bytes of a block that search, metadata and metrics jobs are estimated
+            # to read. Must satisfy 0 < min_factor <= max_factor <= 1. Raise max_factor for small blocks.
+        # Fixed estimate in bytes for jobs that read recent data from the live stores.
+        # Set to 0 to not estimate these jobs.
### Limit query size to improve performance and stability
| `tempo_query_frontend_executing_jobs` | Jobs currently executing on queriers, per tenant and operation |
| `tempo_query_frontend_job_inspected_bytes` | Histogram of the bytes inspected by each querier job that responded with metrics, per operation, excluding cached job responses |

+| `tempo_query_frontend_job_actual_to_estimated_bytes_ratio` | Histogram of the bytes a job inspected divided by the bytes it was estimated to read, per operation and `kind`, for jobs with an estimate greater than zero |
+| `tempo_query_frontend_job_cost_factor` | Share of the bytes of the block range a job covers that it is estimated to read, per operation. Not reported for trace by ID |
+| `tempo_query_frontend_job_cost_bytes_per_block` | Bytes a trace by ID job is estimated to read per block it looks into, always with `op="traces"` |
